traits.name: Draconic Origin
traits.text: The half-dragon is related to a type of dragon associated with one of the following damage types (GM's choice): Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. This choice affects other aspects of the stat block.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The half-dragon makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +7, reach 10 ft. _Hit:_ 6 (1d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) damage of the type chosen for the Draconic Origin trait.

actions.name: Dragon's Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. _Failure:_ 28 (8d6) damage of the type chosen for the Draconic Origin trait. _Success:_ Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Leap
bonusActions.text: The half-dragon jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement. ## Harpy
